main.description: Every path in a repository's tree at a revision, folders as well as files, the shallowest first: for finding a file by name as it is typed. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

errors.description: No such repository or revision, or a repository never pushed.
errors.name: NotFound

ref.description: The ref or commit read, as `ref` named it.

truncated.description: True when the tree holds more paths than `limit`, and the deepest were left out.

limit.description: The most paths to give: those deepest in the tree are left out first.

ref.description: A branch, a tag or a commit; the default branch if absent.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

kind.description: A directory, a file, or a submodule's commit.

path.description: From the tree's root, with no leading slash.

description: Every path in a repository's tree at a revision.
